violations.issue: PBS streamline codes not provided for psychiatric medications
violations.suggested_fix: Add PBS authority requirements: SSRIs (sertraline, escitalopram) are PBS-listed without authority for depression/anxiety. Lithium requires authority for bipolar disorder. Clozapine requires authority and CPMS registration.

violations.issue: Benzodiazepine dosing could specify 'symptom-triggered' protocol more explicitly
violations.suggested_fix: Clarify that alprazolam should be avoided due to dependence risk per eTG. Diazepam preferred for symptom-triggered regimen.

violations.issue: Lithium + diuretic interaction noted but monitoring frequency not specified
violations.suggested_fix: Add specific recommendation: Check lithium level 3-5 days after starting/changing diuretics, then weekly until stable

suggestions: Consider adding PBS authority requirements for all psychotropic medications (lithium, valproate, clozapine require authority)
Specify TGA-approved formulations for clozapine (Clozaril, Clopine) to aid prescribers
Add renal dosing adjustments for lithium in elderly (initial dose 250mg BD if age >65)
Include therapeutic drug monitoring frequency for valproate (trough level 50-100 mg/L)
Add note about valproate pregnancy prevention program (mandatory in Australia for women of childbearing age)
